beats.cap: A clinic day is mostly *typing.* Names, tokens, bills and notes.
beats.sayPro: [serious] A clinic day is mostly typing. Names, tokens, bills and notes.

beats.cap: The doctor writes, the desk types, and the patient *waits.*
beats.sayPro: [tired] The doctor writes, the desk types, and the patient waits.
[curious] What if you could just say it?

beats.cap: This is the *assistant,* inside Nayaversse. It waits at the foot of every screen.
beats.say: This is the assistant, inside Nayaversse. It waits at the foot of every screen.
beats.sayPro: [warmly] This is the assistant, inside नयावर्स. It waits at the foot of every screen.

beats.cap: One tap, and it *listens.* The doctor says: register a new patient, Sagar Deshpande, age forty.
beats.sayPro: [confident] One tap, and it listens. The doctor says: register a new patient, Sagar Deshpande, age forty.

beats.cap: It shows what it *understood,* and waits. Nothing is saved yet.
beats.sayPro: It shows what it understood, and waits. Nothing is saved yet.

beats.cap: She corrects the age in one sentence. The *same* card changes, never a second record.
beats.sayPro: She corrects the age in one sentence. The same card changes, never a second record.

beats.cap: She says yes, and he is *registered.*
beats.sayPro: [pleased] She says yes, and he is registered.

beats.cap: Ask in English, Hindi or Marathi, the way people really *mix* them.
beats.sayPro: Ask in English, Hindi or Marathi, the way people really mix them.

beats.cap: A payment is one sentence: Ganesh paid four hundred by *UPI.*
beats.sayPro: A payment is one sentence: Ganesh paid four hundred by U P I.

beats.cap: One yes, and the bill is *settled.* Nothing changes until somebody confirms.
beats.sayPro: One yes, and the bill is settled. Nothing changes until somebody confirms.

beats.cap: Every login can do only what that person is *allowed* to. The pharmacist cannot take payments.
beats.sayPro: Every login can do only what that person is allowed to. The pharmacist cannot take payments.

beats.cap: In the consulting room it listens to the visit: Hindi and English, *together.*
beats.sayPro: [softly] In the consulting room it listens to the visit: Hindi and English, together.

beats.cap: Then it drafts the note: the *complaint,* the history and the diagnosis.
beats.sayPro: Then it drafts the note: the complaint, the history and the diagnosis.

beats.cap: The medicines, the tests and the follow-up. Saved only when the doctor *confirms.*
beats.sayPro: [reassuring] The medicines, the tests and the follow-up. Saved only when the doctor confirms.

beats.say: Nayaversse. The clinic's assistant, in trial now. Book a demo at nayaversse dot in.
beats.sayPro: [warmly] नयावर्स. The clinic's assistant, in trial now. [friendly] Book a demo at नयावर्स dot in.
